title: Distinguished completions with the compatible relative Mayer--Vietoris boundaries
statement: Let g′:X′→X, f′:X′→S′, f:X→S and g:S′→S form a cartesian square of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-pc-base-change]. Assume S,S′ affine and f quasi-compact and quasi-separated. Let K∈D_QCoh(O_X), K′∈D_QCoh(O_X′), and φ:L(g′)K→K′ [def-pc-derived-category, def-pc-derived-pullback]. Let U,V cover X with U,V and U∩V quasi-compact. Fix the source and target pair-of-unit and difference-of-restriction maps of [def-pc-relative-mv-maps], on the sources and targets of the specified canonical local arrows. There exist boundaries δ from the source overlap term to the shifted global source and δ′ from the target overlap term to the shifted global target, completing these fixed two-arrow sequences to distinguished triangles [def-weil-triangulated-category]. The connecting square δ≫αX[1]=α(U∩V)≫δ′ commutes. Neither of the two restriction squares nor a morphism of triangles is asserted.

proof.text: The affine morphism g [lem-weil-pbc-morphism-affine-schemes-affine] has affine and qcqs base change g′ [lem-weil-pbc-affine-morphism-permanence]. The sources of f and f′ are qcqs [lem-weil-pbc-qcqs-over-affine]. Inverse images of the compact opens and overlap under g′ are compact and cover X′. Apply the functorial Mayer--Vietoris construction [lem-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-triangle, lem-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-functorial] to both covers.

proof.text: Identify the exact restrictions [def-pc-derived-open-restriction-maps] with open derived pullbacks by the derived universal property [def-pc-derived-pullback]. Take right-adjoint mates [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-adjoint] of the pinned composition comparisons [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] to identify the open direct-image terms. These identifications give exactly the fixed maps [def-pc-relative-mv-maps]. Apply the triangulated functors Lg*Rf* and Rf′* [def-pc-derived-pullback, lem-pc-right-derived-functor-triangulated], and transport both boundaries and distinguishedness along the term and biproduct identifications.

proof.text: Transpose φ under the pinned derived adjunction [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]; its direct-image target has quasi-coherent cohomology [lem-pc-derived-direct-image-preserves-qcoh]. Naturality of the short-exact-sequence boundaries and their compatibility with direct image [lem-pc-derived-mayer-vietoris-functorial] give the adjoint boundary square. Transpose back using the shift compatibility of the derived adjunction and derived functors. Expand the mate [def-pc-derived-base-change-map]; associativity and the pullback equality [lem-pc-ringed-spaces-derived-pullback-composition] identify its overlap component with the specified canonical arrow. This proves the boundary equation without asserting either of the restriction squares.

theorem relativeMV_boundary_completion
    [∀ Z : Scheme.{u},
      HasDerivedCategory.{w} (SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings Z.toRingedSpace))]
    {X S X' S' : Scheme.{u}}
    (f : X ⟶ S) (f' : X' ⟶ S') (g : S' ⟶ S) (g' : X' ⟶ X)
    (hpull : IsPullback g' f' f g)
    (K : schemeDerivedCategory X) (K' : schemeDerivedCategory X')
    (φ : (derivedPullback g').obj K ⟶ K')
    [IsAffine S] [IsAffine S'] [QuasiCompact f] [QuasiSeparated f]
    (hK : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X K) (hK' : schemeDerivedQCohProperty X' K')
    (U V : X.Opens)
    (hUqc : IsCompact (U : Set X)) (hVqc : IsCompact (V : Set X))
    (hUVqc : IsCompact ((U ⊓ V : X.Opens) : Set X)) (hcover : U ⊔ V = ⊤) :
    let a := relativeMVLocalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    let aX := relativeMVGlobalArrow f f' g g' hpull K K' φ
    ∃ (δ : (a (U ⊓ V)).left ⟶ aX.left⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧)
      (δ' : (a (U ⊓ V)).right ⟶ aX.right⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧),
      Triangle.mk (relativeMVSourceFirst f g U V K)
        (relativeMVSourceSecond f g U V K) δ ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory S') ∧
      Triangle.mk (relativeMVTargetFirst g' f' U V K')
        (relativeMVTargetSecond g' f' U V K') δ' ∈ distTriang (schemeDerivedCategory S') ∧
      δ ≫ aX.hom⟦(1 : ℤ)⟧' = (a (U ⊓ V)).hom ≫ δ'
